text: The wing polar models finite-wing effects and post-stall behavior. The configured 15° stall reference is an assumption.

The configured inputs include lift slope 4.0 per radian, CL0 = 0.10, CD0 = 0.02 and Oswald efficiency = 0.80. The study changes the low-speed load onset from a sharp cutoff to a blend across 0.5–2.5 m/s. Startup propwash can yield high effective incidence below wingborne speed, so a separate low-speed flow guard is used. The low-order model does not establish aircraft stall behavior.

text: The solver accepts a bounded solution when the largest absolute normalized residual is ≤ 0.005.

SciPy bounded least squares uses an exact CasADi residual Jacobian. The starts try the nearest coarse-grid solution, the prior speed’s converged solution, a hover start, and a lower-thrust tilted start. The solver retains the lowest-residual result. An optimizer status flag alone is insufficient. Electrical and wingborne incidence are checked on the resulting candidate. Finite-rate constraints belong to trajectory replay.
